title.zh: 宇树 Go2 四足机器人

evidence.quote: Max Running Speed  Approx. 5m/s  (tested in lab)

notes.zh: 回答四足本体的重量、载荷、续航与感知配置，用来判断场地与实验类型。注意三个容易误读的地方：5m/s 是实验室条件；续航 1–4 小时随机型与电池容量变化；工作最大功率约 3000W 属瞬时峰值，不能按此推算平均供电。价格不收录。
notes.en: Answers the weight, payload, endurance and perception setup of a quadruped body, which is what decides the floor space and experiment type it suits. Three figures are easy to misread: 5 m/s is a laboratory figure; endurance ranges from 1 to 4 hours depending on variant and battery; and the ~3000 W working maximum is a transient peak that must not be used to size average power. Price is excluded.

specs.payload: about 7-8 kg (max 10-12 kg depending on variant)
specs.endurance: about 1-2 h; 2-4 h with long-endurance battery
specs.perception: 4D LiDAR L2, 360° x 96°, minimum detection 0.05 m; HD wide-angle camera
